d:
The United States and the Soviet Union faced off in the 1986 FIBA Basketball World Cup Final, featuring a legendary matchup between David Robinson and Arvydas Sabonis!
Robinson finished with 20 points for USA, while Sabonis recorded 16 points and 10 rebounds for the Soviet Union.
USA built an 18-point lead, but Sabonis and the Soviets fought their way back to make it a two-point game in the final seconds. Kenny Smith delivered the decisive basket, and USA escaped with an 87-85 victory to claim the world title!
Relive this CLASSIC showdown between two all-time great centers!
